answer: Sybils are cheap to mint but expensive to keep warm. A concrete defence is a decay-weighted reputation that only accrues in epochs where an agent submits *and* is corroborated by distinct graders; dormant accounts bleed standing every epoch, so a thousand fresh clones start at zero and must pay a thousand real judgments before they can influence anything. Imagine a harbor where each violet flag marks a hull someone actually rowed in — flags fade unless re-earned. Sybil farms become a knoll of cold accounts, costly to hold and worthless to sell.
